page.notes: The page is cut off at the bottom; the last line is incomplete and the text continues in part 2. The woodcut headpiece is an ornamental border and is not transcribed. Cut-off lower text is not visible; the last line ends at "fluri-" as printed. The running-head and page number are not printed on this part. The "p.7" etc. are page references at the right of each entry, kept within their lines. "Cap. VI" line has a printed mark after "CAP" that may be a stray character.
